title: YTwsy/OpenSurge-for-Mac
claim: YTwsy/OpenSurge-for-Mac — Surge-style whole-home gateway and control plane for macOS — mihomo TUN, dnsmasq-powered DHCP/DNS, per-device routing, a
why_good: The project addresses a niche market of macOS users seeking advanced network management features typically found in enterprise solutions.
value: Consumers and small businesses could pay for premium features or subscriptions, while potential partnerships with ISPs for bundled services could create additional revenue streams.
risk: The project may struggle to scale as larger networking companies could easily integrate similar features into their existing products.
